// Generated by BIMOS Active Ragdolls (Tools > Active Ragdoll > Install BIMOS Demo Weapon Support).
// Safe to delete; regenerate from the same menu. Lives in your project because the BIMOS demo scripts are
// imported samples, which a package cannot reference directly.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using ActiveRagdoll;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
using SampleDamageable = BIMOS.Samples.IDamageable;

namespace ActiveRagdoll.BIMOSDemo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The BIMOS demo weapons damage whatever they hit through <c>BIMOS.Samples.IDamageable.TakeDamage</c> on
    /// the hit collider. This bridge sits on every active-ragdoll and BIMOS-player collider and forwards those
    /// hits into the active ragdoll damage system (body-part multipliers, pain, stagger, death, player health).
    /// </summary>
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    [AddComponentMenu("")]
    public sealed class BIMOSDemoDamageBridge : MonoBehaviour, SampleDamageable
    {
        /// <summary>The demo pistol deals 10 per hit; this scales it (3 = 30 body / 75 head on a 100 HP NPC).</summary>
        public static float DamageScale = 3f;

        /// <summary>Set by NPC-fired demo guns for the duration of a shot (damage attribution/aggro).</summary>
        public static GameObject CurrentShooter;
        public static Transform CurrentMuzzle;

        private Collider _collider;

        private void Awake()
        {
            _collider = GetComponent<Collider>();
        }

        public void TakeDamage(float damageAmount)
        {
            if (_collider == null)
                _collider = GetComponent<Collider>();
            ActiveRagdoll.IDamageable target = Damageables.Find(_collider);
            if (target == null || damageAmount <= 0f)
                return;

            Vector3 point = _collider != null ? _collider.bounds.center : transform.position;
            Vector3 direction = CurrentMuzzle != null ? (point - CurrentMuzzle.position).normalized : Vector3.zero;
            if (TryFindShot(out RaycastHit shot, out Vector3 shotDirection))
            {
                point = shot.point; // the real bullet hole, for blood and hit reactions
                direction = shotDirection;
            }
            // The demo gun already pushed the hit rigidbody; only damage is added here.
            target.ApplyDamage(new DamageInfo(damageAmount * DamageScale, DamageType.Bullet, point, direction,
                Vector3.zero, CurrentShooter, _collider));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The demo IDamageable doesn't say where the bullet hit. Re-trace it: the firing barrel is either the
        /// NPC's (CurrentMuzzle) or whichever demo pistol's barrel ray hits this collider nearest.
        /// </summary>
        private bool TryFindShot(out RaycastHit hit, out Vector3 direction)
        {
            hit = default;
            direction = Vector3.zero;
            if (_collider == null)
                return false;
            float best = float.PositiveInfinity;
            if (CurrentMuzzle != null)
                Consider(CurrentMuzzle, ref hit, ref direction, ref best);
            else
                foreach (NPCWeapon weapon in NPCWeapon.All)
                    if (weapon is BIMOSDemoPistolWeapon && weapon.Muzzle != null)
                        Consider(weapon.Muzzle, ref hit, ref direction, ref best);
            return best < float.PositiveInfinity;
        }

        private void Consider(Transform muzzle, ref RaycastHit hit, ref Vector3 direction, ref float best)
        {
            var ray = new Ray(muzzle.position, muzzle.forward);
            if (_collider.Raycast(ray, out RaycastHit candidate, 1000f) && candidate.distance < best)
            {
                best = candidate.distance;
                hit = candidate;
                direction = ray.direction;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Adds bridges and NPC weapon adapters automatically.</summary>
    public static class BIMOSDemoWeaponsBootstrap
    {
        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.BeforeSceneLoad)]
        private static void Initialize()
        {
            ActiveRagdollCharacter.Initialized -= OnCharacter;
            ActiveRagdollCharacter.Initialized += OnCharacter;
            CombatTarget.Registered -= OnTarget;
            CombatTarget.Registered += OnTarget;
            NPCWeapon.DiscoveryHandler -= DiscoverWeapons;
            NPCWeapon.DiscoveryHandler += DiscoverWeapons;
            SceneManager.sceneLoaded -= OnSceneLoaded;
            SceneManager.sceneLoaded += OnSceneLoaded;
        }

        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.AfterSceneLoad)]
        private static void AfterSceneLoad()
        {
            foreach (ActiveRagdollCharacter c in ActiveRagdollCharacter.All)
                OnCharacter(c);
            foreach (CombatTarget t in CombatTarget.Active)
                OnTarget(t);
            DiscoverWeapons();
        }

        private static void OnSceneLoaded(Scene scene, LoadSceneMode mode) => DiscoverWeapons();

        private static void OnCharacter(ActiveRagdollCharacter character)
        {
            if (character == null)
                return;
            foreach (RagdollBone bone in character.Bones)
                if (bone.body != null)
                    AddBridges(bone.body.transform);
        }

        private static void OnTarget(CombatTarget target)
        {
            if (target == null)
                return;
            BIMOS.Player player = target.GetComponentInParent<BIMOS.Player>();
            if (player == null)
                player = target.GetComponentInChildren<BIMOS.Player>();
            if (player != null)
                AddBridges(player.transform);
        }

        private static void AddBridges(Transform root)
        {
            foreach (Collider c in root.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>(true))
            {
                if (c.isTrigger || c.TryGetComponent(out SampleDamageable _))
                    continue;
                c.gameObject.AddComponent<BIMOSDemoDamageBridge>();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Gives every demo pistol an NPC adapter so NPCs can pick it up and fire it.</summary>
        public static void DiscoverWeapons()
        {
            foreach (BIMOS.Samples.Pistol pistol in Object.FindObjectsByType<BIMOS.Samples.Pistol>(FindObjectsSortMode.None))
                if (pistol.GetComponent<NPCWeapon>() == null)
                    pistol.gameObject.AddComponent<BIMOSDemoPistolWeapon>();
        }
    }
}
